entry: app/layout.tsx -> app/globals.css -> q-design.foundation.css + q-design.workspace.css + q-design.components.css + q-design.palette.css; global-error imports the same styles explicitly; offline HTML embeds its own generated central CSS
scope: All former authored global, expert-theme and sheet-paper CSS recipes are central, including print rules and ordering. Auth, status, ribbon and 22 embedded CSS blocks from 19 TSX files are central. UI scales, confirmed literal styles and numeric UI contracts have exact ledgers. Data-derived layout and measured coordinates remain runtime inputs; static parameters are not exempt merely because they are numeric.

rules: Global CSS contains imports only; former expert and sheet files contain ownership comments.
Exact original-source sections remain marked in the imported generated CSS so contract tests read actual runtime recipes.
Breakpoints, print, focus-visible, coarse-pointer and reduced-motion selectors retain their original order.
Screen FS, S, LH, F and regular radius reads -> QDScale CSS references; numeric exports in tokens.ts stay unchanged.

The first AST phase retains 12017 transformation events; 91 further reviewed events resolve skipped CSS-safe references. These are historical edit counts, not a claim about current rendered instances.
foldGrid accepts number or CSS length. Numeric calculations preserve their former output; CSS lengths remain live inside calc. Grid and SegmentedChoice gaps accept CSS lengths.
Negative spacing and summed spacing use CSS calc. Round indicators use --qd-radius-full; ordinary components use --qd-radius.
Only five executable direct scale references remain in app, components and lib/design outside locked tokens and fallback adapters: two S[1] and three LH.snug reads in tag-metrics.ts.
Auth form width, columns, brand/form/mobile/card spacing, title size, surfaces and shadows -> --qd-auth-*.
Auth card corner visibility -> --qd-auth-card-corner-display.
Ambient ribbon position, layers, opacity, motion and vignette -> central recipe and --qd-ribbon-*.
Theme toggle appearance and minimum touch target are class-based; authentication behavior is unchanged.
Error and not-found screens use shared qa-status classes; root error imports bundled fonts and product CSS.
Public legal and open-source layouts use central marked recipes.
Offline HTML is generated with central foundation, component variables, palette and dedicated recipe embedded; no external stylesheet is required offline.
Expert background/surface/text/subtle/muted/accent aliases resolve shared semantic palette variables.
Danger, verified, pending, progress and rejected states resolve --qd-danger/ok/warn/info.
Risk critical/high/medium/low/unknown resolve danger/warn/warn/ok/muted; text labels preserve risk-level distinctions.
Former RGB channel copies now use color-mix on live semantic colors.
Danger cards use an opaque surface and complete thin border. Auth and expert glass blur is removed.
Meeting input visual rules use a unique stable scope class. Theme-specific native picker filters resolve central variables.
Dynamic collapse-label content uses a data attribute and CSS attr; count remains application data.

309 confirmed static, conditional and constant presentation values in nine core files consume central values. Dynamic conditions are retained; only their presentation outcomes change to variable references.
Tag rendered sizes use 18 per-size central parameters for font size, gap, min-height, padding and dot size. Numeric TAG_DIMS remains a reference model and CSS fallback.

Coarse-pointer minimum size uses --qd-control-height even with !important. Progress default height uses --qd-progress-height and ordinary shared radius; explicit numeric height props remain supported.
Known untyped style maps in permissions-matrix, regulatory-calendar, ApprovalChainEditor, BackButton and DocsetStructurePanel use central spacing, tracking, weight and size values.
Q-Design source/design/atelier-runtime.ts owns BP, LAYOUT and ICON numeric UI inputs. 106 named import declarations now consume its generated product copy; locked engine tokens are unchanged.
346 fixed numeric alpha arguments across the audited UI consume 28 central factors. Data-derived ratios and explicit caller values are preserved.
Switch sizes and inset, Grid and foldGrid default minimum column widths and rounding allowance, grain tint and all six ribbon SMIL durations consume central numeric inputs.

34 authored media-query widths use named qd-bp markers. build-foundation and source extractors resolve them from the same BP object used by JavaScript. No unsupported CSS custom properties enter media queries.
Changing numeric configuration requires sync and normal product rebuild. It is not a runtime CSS custom property; its source and generated copy are hash-checked.
Avatar and information-popover numeric defaults consume source/design/atelier-runtime.ts. Measured positions and explicit caller dimensions remain runtime data.
Department badge padding is centrally defined; badge, chart-label, comment and vault UI type/spacing uses QDScale.
327 grid/column literal branches and332 conditional CSS literal branches use central defaults. Exact site/value ledgers distinguish migrations from generated central copies.

runtimeBoundaries.reason: Numeric token and engine dependency sources remain unchanged. UI adapters consume CSS variables with locked numeric fallbacks. Five engine IDs were compared read-only against HEAD and saved evidence; all match.
Numeric tag height arithmetic remains intact. Actual Tag rendering independently consumes central per-size CSS variables, so the model is the fallback reference rather than a frozen render override.

Grid emits per-instance CSS from caller column counts, responsive props and explicit minimum widths. Defaults and breakpoints now resolve the central numeric UI contract. Measured geometry and explicit runtime data are preserved; static values are not a blanket exception.

Chart values, viewBox/path coordinates, camera framing, measured overlay positions and progress ratios remain numeric data. SVG text families and identified screen presentation parameters are central. Static styling in these files is not categorically exempt.

Approved background components are now fingerprint-verified copies of patterns/foundation/atelier-backgrounds.tsx. Exact rendered artwork/gradient/motion output is preserved, and mutations to the central artwork or duration reach the original product wrapper. Fonts remain bundled resources and generated icons retain the central generator contract.

Print pagination, millimetre dimensions, physical column fit, record content and export geometry retain paper contracts. Former authored print CSS is central and DOCX colors already consume generated document tokens. This does not exempt new literal fonts/colors from review.

negativeFindings: No executable FS/S/LH/F/RADIUS display references remain in audited app/components/lib/design except five numeric tag model reads and the explicit token/fallback adapters.
No inline style JSX element remains in app/components TSX. Grid in lib/design/components.tsx still emits dynamic layout CSS and is recorded above.

The historical literal ledger excludes selected extractor inputs, engine dependencies, print and dynamic expressions. The core and numeric ledgers close the reviewed static gaps in those UI contexts. Only actual data-derived or measured geometry is treated as runtime data; remaining inventory entries still require evidence-based classification.
The migration does not imply that every screen has been exercised with real authenticated data. Browser evidence uses actual representative components and auth layout without production APIs.

verification.mutationGuards: Tests mutate central BP, shell width, icon defaults, switch shape/inset, grid defaults, ribbon duration and alpha factors. Actual renderers, generated media CSS, token output and screen/list/nav extractors must follow. Missing runtime references or named breakpoints fail. Existing CSS-variable and unit guards remain.

final.worktreeExtraction: All four extractors pass isolated current-product source snapshots. Final committed-source refresh is coordinated separately.
